name: Shakotan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shakotan town emblem in navy: a rounded triangle enclosing a stylised character in white.
history: Municipal flag of Shakotan, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 11 August 1966.

features.role: Shakotan town emblem — a rounded triangle enclosing a stylised character in white
